verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a commerce platform, but every documented surface here is Shopify-operated: the Global Catalog at catalog.shopify.com, per-merchant /api/ucp/mcp endpoints, and server-side webhook registration. The open UCP spec and its public reference implementations are protocol building blocks, not a self-hostable Shopify product. The local CLI profile is only client-side configuration, so there is no evidence the core product can be self-hosted.
